r1.name: Entrance Hall
r1.hint: Basic Sword: J. Find the Gloves chest, open the switch gate, then unlock the eastern seal.

r2.name: Mechanism Room
r2.hint: Stand on the entrance plate. Push the heavy crate onto the relay plate to open the final seal.

r3.name: Ruined Library
r3.hint: Weight both plates. Find the Boots chest and the seal key. A cracked alcove hides supplies.

r4.name: Guard Room
r4.hint: Use the amber key. Set the relay signal, start the short clock, and dash through its gate.

r5.name: Crystal Chamber
r5.hint: Find the Mirror. Power both signals, turn light north, and weight the relay plate.

r6.name: Mosswork Vault
r6.hint: Pulse the cracked passage. Find the Magnet, then repel the metal weight across its slot.

r7.name: Star Observatory
r7.hint: Cross the clock gate. Reflect light north and move the remote metal weight onto its plate.

r8.name: Prism Sanctum
r8.hint: Use all four tools to align the seals. Defeat the three southern guards to open the last gate.

r9.name: Hidden Vault
r9.hint: Activate both lantern switches. Open the vault chest beyond the gate, then return west.
